parts:
Hi

I am trying to run the " TumorBoost Normalisation" on my  data set. But I have only 2 normals with 7 tumor samples. The data set is correct, and that is how I intend to pair my samples. My question is in this part of the vignette.

library("aroma.cn");
log <- verbose <- Arguments$getVerbose(-8, timestamp=TRUE);
rootPath <- "totalAndFracBData";
rootPath <- Arguments$getReadablePath(rootPath);
dataSets <- c("TCGA,GBM,BeadStudio,XY", "TCGA,GBM,CRMAv2"); # This is where the problem arises.

I do not have a tag with a "BeadStudio,XY" and a "CRMAv2". I ran the CRMAv2, but it did not generate any files with these tags. 

That part of the Vignette is a little confusing. please carify.

Thanks for the help.

Nitesh

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] TumorBoost - Normalization of allelic-specific copy numbers in tumors with matched normals
parts:
Before anything else, you need to have matched tumor-normal pairs in
order to apply the TumorBoost method.  No exceptions.  So, at best, if
the 2 normals are matched with 2 of the tumors, you can can run
TumorBoost on those 2 pairs.  Is that what you have?

/Henrik
